Market Trend Analysis: The Impact of Emerging Advancements on the Cloud Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Market

📅 May 14, 2026 ✍️ The Business Research Company (press release) 🏷️ cloud GIS, market forecast, geospatial data, AI-powered analytics, smart cities, location intelligence, CAGR
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

The cloud GIS market is projected to reach $4.76 billion by 2030 at a 19.2% CAGR, driven by smart city projects, AI-powered geospatial analytics, real-time location intelligence, and the growing adoption of integrated all-in-one cloud GIS platforms.

📌 Key takeaways

  • The cloud GIS market is expected to reach $4.76 billion by 2030 with a CAGR of 19.2%, fueled by smart cities, AI integration, and climate monitoring.
  • Major players include Google, Microsoft, AWS, Hexagon, Autodesk, Trimble, Maxar, Bentley Systems, HERE Technologies, Mapbox, Nearmap, CARTO, and GIS Cloud.
  • NV5 Global acquired GIS Solutions Inc. in April 2024 to strengthen enterprise cloud GIS capabilities in transportation and utilities.
  • Companies are prioritizing all-in-one cloud GIS platforms that unify data collection, storage, analysis, and visualization.
  • The market spans 15+ end-user industries including agriculture, real estate, oil and gas, construction, mining, transportation, government, utilities, and retail.
